d81e3e96b7fe14f5547f.en: An adverb tells us more about a verb: how, when or where something happens.
d81e3e96b7fe14f5547f.id: Kata keterangan (adverb) memberi tahu lebih banyak tentang kata kerja (verb): bagaimana, kapan, atau di mana sesuatu terjadi.

cfb849e96921742767ef.en: A preposition shows where or when, like under, through, after and during.
cfb849e96921742767ef.id: Kata depan (preposition) menunjukkan tempat atau waktu, seperti under, through, after, dan during.

fd36b94ad31d7fda0d3b.en: Use in for months, on for days and at for clock times.
fd36b94ad31d7fda0d3b.id: Pakai in untuk bulan, on untuk hari, dan at untuk jam.

7a630401c4e7988dd1c1.en: An adverbial can be one word or a phrase. When it moves to the front, it is a fronted adverbial.
7a630401c4e7988dd1c1.id: Adverbial bisa berupa satu kata atau sekelompok kata (phrase). Kalau pindah ke depan, namanya fronted adverbial.

eedb08f00608596bf110.en: Put a comma straight after a fronted adverbial.
eedb08f00608596bf110.id: Taruh koma (comma) tepat setelah fronted adverbial.
